summary: Discusses an IPv6 deployment in which each node on a large broadcast network, such as an enterprise or public Wi-Fi network, receives its own unique prefix through DHCPv6 Prefix Delegation as specified in RFC 8415. It is an informational discussion of the scenario.

eli5.summary: Instead of every device sharing one big street, each device gets its own little street. This explains how a busy network, like a coffee shop's Wi-Fi, can hand those out.

questions: how to give each client its own ipv6 prefix
